question: A municipality designates one certified operator as the overall responsible operator for a wastewater collection system for a shift. Which duty belongs to that operator during the shift?
correctAnswer: Directing system operations and responding to abnormal operating conditions
explanation: The overall responsible operator directs operations for the system and responds when conditions depart from normal, rather than performing every task personally.
options: Completing every field repair personally before any other crew member acts
Directing system operations and responding to abnormal operating conditions
Preparing the annual municipal budget for all departments in the corporation
Approving building permits for new houses connecting to the municipal sewer
optionA: Completing every field repair personally before any other crew member acts
optionB: Directing system operations and responding to abnormal operating conditions
optionC: Preparing the annual municipal budget for all departments in the corporation
optionD: Approving building permits for new houses connecting to the municipal sewer

question: A collection crew reviews its confined space program before the season starts. Which element must the written program include for each manhole entry?

options: A schedule for rotating entry workers so each person enters once monthly
A list of restaurants near the work site for the midday meal break period

A record of vehicle fuel purchases made by the crew during the past year

optionB: A list of restaurants near the work site for the midday meal break period

optionD: A record of vehicle fuel purchases made by the crew during the past year

question: At the manhole where a force main discharges, an operator finds the concrete crown soft and pitted. Which condition most directly drives this damage pattern?
correctAnswer: Hydrogen sulfide released from the flow converts to acid on the crown
explanation: Sulfide released from septic wastewater forms acid on moist crown surfaces above the flow, which attacks concrete and produces the soft, pitted pattern described.
options: Cold winter air entering the manhole through the holes in the cover
Sunlight reaching the pipe wall through the open maintenance hole
Hydrogen sulfide released from the flow converts to acid on the crown
Gravel bedding shifting under the pipe during spring thaw each year
optionA: Cold winter air entering the manhole through the holes in the cover
optionB: Sunlight reaching the pipe wall through the open maintenance hole
optionC: Hydrogen sulfide released from the flow converts to acid on the crown
optionD: Gravel bedding shifting under the pipe during spring thaw each year

question: A station fits a variable speed drive and keeps the same pumped volumes, so energy per cubic metre falls. One pump now runs far below its efficient range at low speed. Which operator decision balances the two effects?
correctAnswer: Setting the speed range so the pump stays near its efficient operating zone
explanation: Keeping the operating speed range near the efficient zone preserves the drive savings without running the pump where it wastes energy and wears faster.
options: Running the pump at the lowest possible speed for every inflow condition
Removing the drive and returning to throttling the discharge valve daily
Pumping the wet well down to the suction bell at the end of each cycle
Setting the speed range so the pump stays near its efficient operating zone

optionC: Pumping the wet well down to the suction bell at the end of each cycle

question: A cleaning budget is cut by one fifth. Condition data show most blockages come from 12 percent of sewers with grease and roots, while the rest stay clean for years. Which program redesign protects service best?
correctAnswer: Keeping frequent cleaning on the hotspot sewers and extending intervals elsewhere
explanation: Concentrating effort on the small share of sewers causing most blockages, and stretching intervals on sewers that stay clean, protects service within the reduced budget.
options: Keeping frequent cleaning on the hotspot sewers and extending intervals elsewhere
Cutting every sewer cleaning frequency by the same one fifth share overall
Stopping cleaning on all small diameter sewers until the budget returns
Spending the whole budget on the largest trunk sewers in the system

optionC: Stopping cleaning on all small diameter sewers until the budget returns

question: During a major storm, the overall responsible operator is managing an overflow, a station alarm, and a crew injury report at the same time. Which prioritization reflects the duties of that role?
correctAnswer: Protecting people first, then limiting the spill, while keeping notifications and records moving

Deferring all notifications until the storm ends and the system returns to normal

Running the standby generator for all pumping during every peak period each day
